pharmakon-insight-1-q8.onnx is Pharmakon's own encoder for Insight (site 2.3.0, 15 November 2026). It is a modified version
of sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2, which is licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0
(https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0; LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt in this folder). Copyright of the original: the
Sentence-Transformers authors (Nils Reimers, Iryna Gurevych) and the authors of the underlying MiniLM model (Microsoft).

Changes made by Pharmakon (Apache-2.0, section 4b): the original float weights were trained further on Pharmakon's own
examples only (the ways people ask each checked answer, and near-miss questions an answer does not answer;
scripts/insight/finetune.py --all --epochs 6), the result was averaged half and half with the original weights
(scripts/insight/export_mix.py, 0.5), and written as an int8 ONNX file with the same inputs and output as the original.
It uses the original vocabulary (vocab.txt, unmodified). Pharmakon's changes are released under the same licence.

sha256(pharmakon-insight-1-q8.onnx) = 4f5059c16139f1d93e5b78df2a4ee7c5728452e46d93d663cca31e23d1c2c2f5
